base_families.meaning: All twenty original families and witnesses are retained. Operations below supersede documentary implementation guesses, not obligations. Actual candidate function and exact patch are resolved only after frozen GREEN. Baseline function anchors identify causal owners, not promised future spelling.

execution_policy.scope: Only a disposable exact candidate copy; never mutate live candidate, tests, oracle or L0. Apply a separately recorded concrete patch with apply_patch. Runner never edits source.
execution_policy.build: Explicit coordinator build lease required. Serial with coordinator and all mutants; one cargo compilation per attempt. Cargo package typst-core test executable for Rust witnesses; typst-wiring CLI for public-only witnesses. Do not run full corpus before focal.
execution_policy.control: Every focal test or public cell must already be GREEN on the pinned unmutated candidate. Control record includes binary and source-state hashes. A baseline debt RED is not a mutant kill.
execution_policy.profiles: Rust independent tests loop all four feature profiles. CLI replay uses all profiles actually present in each frozen case; family 20 requires identity cells in all four profiles.
execution_policy.judgment: Nonapplying, noncompiling, timeout, malformed output, absent test, unknown public observation, or missing GREEN control are Unknown/instrumentation failure, never killed. Compiled witness failure is pending causal review; only exact intended observable deviation can become KILLED. Other panics/errors are not automatic kills.
execution_policy.restoration: After each attempt restore the isolated copy to every frozen candidate hash before the next patch. Preserve failed instrumentation receipts. Never overwrite prior receipts.
execution_policy.budget: At most two unsuccessful attempts on the same cause before stopping for review. Stop or obtain a new build window when the coordinator lease ends. No matrix rerun during instrumentation calibration.
execution_policy.score: Public-envelope calibration has a separate denominator and contributes zero Rust kills. Report mandatory family coverage and concrete mutant score separately; no survivor or mandatory Unknown can be silently excluded.

limitations: Plans are causal defect definitions, not fabricated candidate patches. Exact anchors, single-change applicability and witness sufficiency require inspection after frozen GREEN.
Some baseline names are owner-level search anchors; a new helper may hold the candidate logic. Record actual qualified function and exact patch before each build.
The 22 frozen Rust tests do not substitute for CLI public envelopes. Public-only rows require actual mutated CLI builds.
A survived additional causal mutant must be reported, not hidden behind 20/20 original-family coverage.
